#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Minimal UCI engine that always plays the worst legal move by material."""
import sys
import chess

def worst_move(board: chess.Board) -> chess.Move:
    legal = list(board.legal_moves)
    def score(m):
        b = board.copy()
        # material from the side to move's perspective after the move; lower is worse for us
        b.push(m)
        # value of our material minus opponent, from the mover's perspective (who just moved, so opponent is now to move)
        vals = {chess.PAWN: 1, chess.KNIGHT: 3, chess.BISHOP: 3, chess.ROOK: 5, chess.QUEEN: 9, chess.KING: 0}
        me = not b.turn
        s = 0
        for sq, pc in b.piece_map().items():
            v = vals[pc.piece_type]
            s += v if pc.color == me else -v
        # prefer moves that hang more / give checkmate to opponent: also penalize giving opponent mate
        if b.is_checkmate():
            s -= 1000
        return s
    return min(legal, key=score)

def main():
    board = chess.Board()
    while True:
        line = sys.stdin.readline()
        if not line:
            break
        line = line.strip()
        if line == "uci":
            print("id name Weakfish")
            print("id author local")
            print("option name Skill Level type spin default 20 min 0 max 20")
            print("uciok", flush=True)
        elif line == "isready":
            print("readyok", flush=True)
        elif line.startswith("setoption"):
            pass
        elif line == "ucinewgame":
            board = chess.Board()
        elif line.startswith("position"):
            parts = line.split()
            if "startpos" in parts:
                board = chess.Board()
                if "moves" in parts:
                    for u in parts[parts.index("moves")+1:]:
                        board.push_uci(u)
            elif "fen" in parts:
                i = parts.index("fen")
                fen_parts = []
                j = i+1
                while j < len(parts) and parts[j] != "moves":
                    fen_parts.append(parts[j]); j += 1
                board = chess.Board(" ".join(fen_parts))
                if "moves" in parts:
                    for u in parts[parts.index("moves")+1:]:
                        board.push_uci(u)
        elif line.startswith("go"):
            mv = worst_move(board)
            print(f"bestmove {mv.uci()}", flush=True)
        elif line == "quit":
            break

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
